column1: # match: a plain substring, or "re:<regex>" for a regex against the full URL.
# First matching rule wins. github.com falls through to seed-sections.tsv / triage.
# Extend by adding rows - no code change required.
# Do NOT put `map` in a domain rule: it would tag every subpage on that host,
# and the tag means "has a row in agent-stack-map.md". It is derived instead,
# NVIDIA - specific paths first; `docs.nvidia.com/nemo` would otherwise swallow
# `langchain.com` must stay below `docs.langchain.com` - it is a substring of it.
